import pandas as pd

# File paths for source tables
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_72/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_72/training_1.csv"

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Source0 schema: ['city', 'date', 'fare', 'ride_id']
# Source1 schema: ['city', 'driver_count', 'type']
# Target schema: ['type': string, 'fare': float, 'ride_id': integer, 'driver_count': integer]

# Transformation plan:
# - Join Source0 and Source1 on 'city' (common column)
# - Select and reorder columns to match target schema
# - Ensure data types match target schema
# - Export the result to the specified path

# Perform inner join on 'city'
merged = pd.merge(df0, df1, on='city', how='inner')

# Select and reorder columns as per target schema
result = merged[['type', 'fare', 'ride_id', 'driver_count']]

# Convert data types to match target schema
result['type'] = result['type'].astype(str)
result['fare'] = result['fare'].astype(float)
result['ride_id'] = result['ride_id'].astype(int)
result['driver_count'] = result['driver_count'].astype(int)

# Output file path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_72/target_multisource_cot.csv"

# Save the transformed dataframe to CSV
result.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_72/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_72/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on city
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="city", how="inner")

# Rename 'type' column to match target schema (already 'type')
# Group by 'type' and aggregate sums of fare, ride_id, driver_count
result = joined.groupby("type", as_index=False).agg({
    "fare": "sum",
    "ride_id": "sum",
    "driver_count": "sum"
})

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_72/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
